item.title: Marine forecast — 21NM SSE Wiscasset ME
item.description:
NWS Forecast for: 21NM SSE Wiscasset ME
Atlantic Ocean
Issued by: National Weather Service Gray/Portland, ME

Sunday: E wind 5 to 10 kt becoming SE in the afternoon. Showers likely, mainly between 11am and 2pm. Areas of fog. Seas around 2 ft.

Sunday Night: SSE wind 5 to 10 kt becoming SSW after midnight. A chance of showers before 8pm. Patchy fog. Seas 2 to 3 ft.

Monday: S wind around 10 kt. Mostly sunny. Seas around 3 ft.

Monday Night: S wind around 10 kt becoming SW after midnight. Partly cloudy. Seas 3 to 4 ft.

Tuesday: SSW wind 10 to 15 kt. Sunny. Seas around 3 ft.

Tuesday Night: SW wind 5 to 10 kt becoming W after midnight. Partly cloudy. Seas 2 to 3 ft.

Wednesday: W wind 5 to 10 kt becoming SSW in the afternoon. Sunny. Seas 2 to 3 ft.
